Discussion thread: here

JIRA: ASF JIRA5aa69414-a9e9-3523-82ec-879b028fb15bKAFKA-15143

Please keep the discussion on the mailing list rather than commenting on the wiki (wiki discussions get unwieldy fast).

Motivation

When KIP-478 and KIP-820 were implemented and merged, they introduced the new Processor API, replacing the previously weakly-typed Transformer that were used.

This change to the Processor API also introduced the MockProcessorContext class to the Kafka Streams test-utils to enable unit testing for any topologies, however, with the strongly-typed nature of the API, FixedKeyProcessor cannot use ProcessorContext and in addition the MockProcessorContext, this KIP adds the MockFixedKeyProcessorContext to enable unit testing for FixedKeyProcessor as well.

Along with the introduction of the MockFixedKeyProcessorContext, another interface - TestFixedKeyRecordFactory, is also required to allow for the creation of FixedKeyRecords in a testing capacity, since the existing InternalFixedKeyRecordFactory  should not be used for such a scenario. Internally to the TestFixedKeyRecordFactory  the InternalFixedKeyRecordFactory  is called to abstract any changes away from the public API.

Public Interfaces

The new MockFixedKeyProcessorContext class.

java implements FixedKeyProcessorContext, RecordCollector.Supplier { public MockFixedKeyProcessorContext(); public MockFixedKeyProcessorContext(final Properties config); public MockFixedKeyProcessorContext(final Properties config, final TaskId taskId, final File stateDir); // duplicates the existing MockProcessorContext interface @Override public String applicationId(); @Override public TaskId taskId(); @Override public Map appConfigs(); @Override public Map appConfigsWithPrefix(String prefix); @Override public Serde keySerde(); @Override public Serde valueSerde(); @Override public File stateDir(); @Override public StreamsMetrics metrics(); public void setCurrentSystemTimeMs(long currentSystemTimeMs); public void setCurrentStreamTimeMs(long currentStreamTimeMs); @Override public long currentSystemTimeMs(); // throws IllegalStateException if unset @Override public long currentStreamTimeMs(); // throws IllegalStateException if unset public void setRecordMetadata(String topic, int partition, long offset); @Override public Optional recordMetadata(); // mocked methods ================================================= public void addStateStore(S stateStore); @Override public S getStateStore(String name); @Override public Cancellable schedule(Duration interval, PunctuationType type, Punctuator callback); public List scheduledPunctuators(); public void forward(FixedKeyRecord record); public void forward(FixedKeyRecord record, String childName); public List> forwarded(); public List> forwarded(String childName); public void resetForwards(); @Override public void commit(); public boolean committed(); public void resetCommit(); @Override public RecordCollector recordCollector(); public StateStoreContext getStateStoreContext(); public static final class CapturedPunctuator { public Duration getInterval(); public PunctuationType getType(); public Punctuator getPunctuator(); public void cancel(); public boolean cancelled(); } public static final class CapturedForward { public CapturedForward(FixedKeyRecord fixedKeyRecord); public CapturedForward(FixedKeyRecord fixedKeyRecord, Optional childName); public Optional childName(); public FixedKeyRecord fixedKeyRecord(); @Override public String toString(); @Override public boolean equals(Object o); @Override public int hashCode(); } } ]]>

The new TestFixedKeyRecordFactory class

java FixedKeyRecord createFixedKeyRecord(final K key, final V value, final Headers headers); public static FixedKeyRecord createFixedKeyRecord(final K key, final V value, final long timestamp); public static FixedKeyRecord createFixedKeyRecord(final K key, final V value); public static FixedKeyRecord createFixedKeyRecord(final K key, final V value, final long timestamp, final Headers headers); // All methods call this method and this calls InternalFixedKeyRecordFactory public static FixedKeyRecord createFixedKeyRecord(final Record record); }]]>


Proposed Changes

We add new classes to allow testing custom processor that implement the FixedKeyProcessor class.

Compatibility, Deprecation, and Migration Plan

This KIP only adds a new class, so there is no compatibility concerns.

Test Plan

Regular unit-testing is sufficient.

Documentation Plan

The section on testing should be updated: https://kafka.apache.org/37/documentation/streams/developer-guide/testing.html

Rejected Alternatives

n/a
